hero.description: Production hero heights (px, rounded) measured on the commit before the pricing line and hero subtitle work (e600964f). The hero must stay identical to these at every viewport; the pricing line is absolutely positioned and adds no height. Tolerance is +/-1px, which only absorbs sub-pixel rounding between browsers. Viewports listed in chromiumOnly are content-height driven and differ per browser engine, so they are only asserted on the desktop Chromium project.
